talas.t: Still awake. Cousin says the Iyık Janyl flat has a damp corner by the window
Damp corners are normal in the valley lol. Ask if the stove is included
Up before the cows. Frost on the potato rows, first real one this year
Morning! Wear the hat today, Nurzhan said minus 5 last night and Talas is not much better 🧣
Hat is for kids. I have a kalpak 😤
Kayırluu tañ! Is the 14 bus running today or should I walk to Semiz?
Walk, the 14 is still stuck at the North Terminal. Take marshrutka instead, 30 som to Kyzyl-Adyr side
Rahmat, marshrutka it is 🙏
Salam all. Anyone know a shop that still sells a cheap charger for old Nokia type phones? 😅
Rustam is the man for that. Ask him, he fixes everything 😂
Ha. Bring it to the counter, I'll look. No promises on the old ones
Opened the booth. Dollar at the bazar 11.45 buy, 11.95 sell this morning. Bank still 8.40
Bazar is quieter than usual. People are waiting for the weekend
Mostly people changing for the Nurzhan trip. Nobody wants tenge lol
[sticker: horse_love]
Marat you were at the Hippodrome at 6am again?
Two horses need a walk. The grey one kicked the gate again 😄
Old City this morning, the sun is on the mountains and the fog is in the valley. Almost like a postcard 🌄
Nurzhan is under smog again. Rustam, your cousin says it is hard to breathe there?
Yeah, the counter guys all have masks now. Here in Talas it's nicer, the air is 91 on the app, moderate
Kids asked why the sky is brown in Nurzhan. I said it is the stoves and the refinery. They said oh 😅
Heating is on everywhere. Coal is 40 som a sack in the village, don't ask me how much in town
Please don't, I'm still paying the gas bill from last winter
Lunch at the Tündük, plov is 28 som and worth every tiyn
Your plov fan club meets Thursday then 😂
I'll bring the bread, nan is 3.50 at the corner
Tulpar training was in the rain on Sunday. The lads still look sharp. Round 27 was a tough one at Nurzhan
Lost 2-1 to Neftchi, I still say we were the better side 🐎
We were, the table says otherwise. 1 point behind at the end, that's still a season 🙂
Cup final is 7 Nov already done lol. Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom, sad for Attelkom
Still not over the pitch at Nurzhan 😅
Anyone going to the women's league? Tulpar Talas finished top, nice work
Tulpar 23, Universitet 22. My students were arguing about it all week
Ha. I'll come to the Hippodrome for the ulak then
Ulak on the 21st: Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr, 19:00 at the State Hippodrome. Who is coming?
Me, with the flask. Last time it was minus 3 at the end
Ulak fans with the thermos 😂 Bring the good tea
Someone asked me today the rate for Kazakh tenge. The changers say 13.15 buy 14.35 for 100 rubles, lol, not tenge. Confusing
Ask them to write it on paper next time 😂
Kids back from nursery with paint all over. Shall I tell you the colours or the story?
Story please 😄
A mountain, a horse, and a boy who lost his hat. Then the boy found the hat on the horse. Obviously
[sticker: horse_love]
Still no word on the Jibek Jolu fire report. My aunt is taking orders from home now
Tell her to message me if she wants her cakes to the kindergarten party 🎂
Rahmat, she will. She makes the best kurut cake
Anyone know if the bus to Iyık Janyl is 45 som still? Thinking of going next weekend
Yes 45 som, 2 hours if the pass is clear. Don't go Friday evening, the road is crowded
Jakshı, thanks Bakyt
Power has been steady all day here. No cuts announced for Talas
Good. My fridge loves that
Thursday Tündük reminder: 18:30, bring questions and a small joke. Students, come, the teahouse is warm 🍵
I'll be there. Should I speak Iradi or English first?
Whatever you like. Mixed is best. Boorsok is on Nurbek
I said I'll bring bread, not boorsok 😤
Bread then, rahmat 😂
Evening all. Tyre shop closed early, cold is coming and everyone wants winter tyres on the Trans-Talas
Winter tyres are required on the Ala-Bel road now, chains in the car too. Check before you drive
Yes, I told two customers already. Ala-Bel is open but they need chains
Dollar at the bazar 11.45 buy and 11.95 sell at lunch. Went down a bit, maybe tomorrow it goes up 🤷
Bazar is the black side, remember 😂
Kids asleep. Now it's my time. Clear sky over Talas tonight? 🌙
Clear over the Old City, the mountains look like sugar 🍬 Minus 4 at midnight they say
Potatoes at 2.10 per kilo in the valley now. Still cheap for the season
Buy a sack then. Aizada, you want potatoes for your students? 😂
Only the English kind of potatoes, I'm not carrying a sack to Tündük 😂
Ulak on the 21st, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr. Marat your knees are ready?
Knees are fine, it's the back that complains 😄
Anyone watching the ISEZ table? Chu on top with 26 points, Talas second on 22
Talas v Dastgoh was 2-3 on the 14th. Bad luck. Still second, the Hippodrome is ours on the 21st
Rahmat Timur. Kyzyl-Adyr won 4-2 at Köhne Diz on the 14th, they're in form
Form is nothing. Horses know when a team wants it
Our flat in Iyık Janyl: 600-1000 for one room, bus 45 som. My cousin says yes if the stove works
Ask about the stove first, then the window frames 😄
Quiet night in the Old City. Who is still up? Tündük Thursday, bring a question 📚
Me. Repairing a screen from a shop customer, lol 😅
Early shift again tomorrow. Night Talas 🌙
[sticker: jakshi]
Night. Potatoes at 5 again 🥔
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Night all, rahmat for the chat 🍵
Cash count at 6 again. Night Talas 🙃
Night 🌙
Night Talas. Early start at the counter tomorrow 👋
Still up. Screen repair finished at midnight, the customer is happy 😅
Rustam go to sleep 😂 the screen will still be broken tomorrow
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the potato rows, minus something this morning
Kayırluu tañ! Clear sky over the Old City again, the mountains are very bright ❄️
Clear in Talas, but Nurzhan says fog. Rustam you still there or did you move to the fog?
Here in Talas. Yesterday I thought I could see my old flat from the bus, lol no
Bus 14 to the centre was on time today. Miracle 🙏
Who's going to the Hippodrome on the 21st? Ulak Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00 🐎
I am. Taking the knees, the back stays home
Wait it's not Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00 on the 21st? Going by the sheet it's the Hippodrome, I'll be there after the cash count
Yes, 19:00 State Hippodrome. Early shift on the 21st, I'll come straight after
Potatoes at the bazar this morning? Bakyt you said 2.10 in the valley
Valley price is 2.10 per kilo, the bazar in town is a bit higher. Buy a sack from me in Kalmak-Ashuu, no bazar fees 😄
Bakyt you are not a seller, you are a potato grower 😂
Ask the Jibek Jolu traders anything today? My aunt still at home selling
Nothing new I heard. Courts wait for the fire report. Sorry Nurbek
Rahmat. At least the dollar is calmer this morning
Changers say 11.55 buy and 11.90 sell at the bazar this morning. Lower than last night 🤷
Still the black side, Begaiym 😂
I'm not black side, I'm cash side. Different thing 😤
Thursday Tündük exchange still on? Teachers from the centre want to come. Bring a question 📚
Rahmat Aizada. I'll come this time. What do I say? My Iradi is still chala 😅
Say salam and 'men Rustamman'. That's already a conversation 🙂
Jakshı, my three kids are off to school in the cold. Kids in coats, I'm in two sweaters 🥶
Air in Talas is unhealthy for sensitive people today, Nurzhan is worse. Close the windows, kids inside at recess 😷
Nurzhan is 170 on the US scale, that's unhealthy for everybody. Ugh, the stove smoke
Refinery smell in Nurzhan and now the stove smoke. Glad I'm in Talas now
Our village has clear air, the wind takes everything to Nurzhan 😄
Tyre shop is full today. Everybody wants winter tyres before the pass, all of the sudden
Ice on the Fergana road for the Gateway trucks, chains or winter tyres required. Careful Marat
Fine. I sell chains, I'm happy. Everyone drives carefully 🙏
Anyone in Talas know if the Tündük café does lunch today?
Yes, the soup is good. Plov is on too, 28 som a plate, a bit expensive but fine
Kech. Going at 1, see you there
Anyone checked the Toktogul reservoir? My husband says the water level is dropping fast
83.5% full, drawing down, minus 48 million m3 in a day. Not dramatic but it's dropping
Water in the canal is still fine for the potatoes. Power is normal too, no cuts
Good, no cuts. Kids are watching cartoons with the lights on 😂
Who wants to practise English with me on Thursday? I'll bring a list of idioms 📚
Idioms about money please. I need them at the booth 😂
'Cash is king' and 'pay on the nail' 😂
Hey, my shop got a phone with a cracked screen and the owner wants it back in 2 hours. Any good place for spare glass?
Ask at the Attelkom kiosks near Communications Square, they had glass last week
Rahmat, I'll walk there
Horses are fine at the stables, cold but fine. Hay is 26 a bale in the valleys, my horses eat more than me
Hay is 26 a bale and you are still complaining? 😂
Not complaining, I'm reporting 🐎
Anyone heard how the Irad Cup final went? Neftchi won 2-0 on the 7th I think
Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom, yes. Shame for Attelkom. Our Tulpar is still second in the league though 😅
Neftchi are champions, we know. Tulpar 62, Neftchi 63, one point gap. Not over until the play-offs 😅
Kids on the bus this afternoon, one of them asked why the mountains are white. Good question from a 6 year old
Snow on top, sugar on the bread lol. Kids are so honest 😂
Thinking about getting a 1-room flat in Iyık Janyl for my sister, 600-1000 a month. Is the stove a problem there?
Ask about the stove first 😄 and the bus is 45 som to Talas, not cheap
Rahmat, I'll ask. The inversion in Iyık Janyl is bad, fog all day
Fog, inversion, smoke. Iyık Janyl is the bowl of the valley. Nothing moves the air there
Ulak fans, the Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at the Hippodrome, Saturday. I'll bring the big drum 🥁
Drums at the Hippodrome? The neighbours will complain 😂
Neighbours are the horses. They like it
ISEZ table check: Chu 26, Talas 22, Dastgoh 16, Iyık Janyl 16, Nurzhan 15. Talas plays Dastgoh? Ahh no, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr on the 21st
Yes, Kyzyl-Adyr. Dastgoh was the 14th, we lost 2-3. Still the Hippodrome is ours
Form is nothing, Marat said. Horses know
Glass fitted, screen works, the owner is happy. Thank you Timur 🙏
Rahmat Rustam. Glad it worked
Tomorrow I'm bringing soup to the kindergarten. Who wants to help make it? 🍲
I can bring bread. Nan is 3.50 a loaf at the Tündük shop 😂
Nan is good. Rahmat
Black side again 😂
Anyone else noticing the Tulparcoin is down? Someone said 3.42 cents, -5.2% today
Not legal tender, Nurbek. Don't put your potatoes money in it 😄
Potatoes are real money. Tulparcoin is a sticker collection
Taxi from the station to the Old City is 15 som from now. Winter rates, they are not cheap
Taxi from Talas to Nurzhan is cheaper by marshrutka, 38 som. Bus 32, but slower
Going home by the 30 som marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr tonight. Bus is full of students
Evening all. Who is at the Tündük café tonight? It's Tuesday, quiet
Kids asleep. Now it's my time. Clear sky over Talas tonight? 🌙
Clear over the Old City. Minus 5 at midnight they say, mountains like sugar 🍬
Frost again. Potatoes will be fine, the sacks are covered
Kids and your potatoes again 😂 Okay Bakyt
Round 11 Sat 21 Nov, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00 at the Hippodrome. Who's coming with me? 🐎
Me. And the drum
I'll come after the lesson, if the bus runs 😄
Don't forget Kara-Bulak at Dastgoh works ground the same day, 16:00. Chu v Sary-Bulak was 6-3 on the 14th
Elnur you are reading the whole ulak sheet now? 😂
Only the ones my cousin plays in 😄
Kids of the teachers at the school near me are all coughing. The smoke again
Keep them inside, dampen the stove, open the window for 5 minutes only 🙏
Anyone know if the Nurzhan Jibek Jolu fire report is out? Herald had nothing today
Not out. Court adjourned, waiting. Sorry Nurbek
Rahmat, the wait is the worst part
Sat 12 Dec, play-off semi-finals at the Hippodrome, 19:00 and 21:00. Who has tickets?
Me. Season ticket holder for Tulpar Talas, I'll be there. ISEZ place 1 v Highland place 2 first
Horse people always go to the second game. Good people stay late
Quiet night in the Old City. Who is still up? Tündük Thursday, bring a question 📚
Me. Writing my Iradi questions for Thursday, lol. Kayırluu tañ tomorrow
Early shift again. Night Talas 🌙
Night. Potatoes at 5 again 🥔
Cash count at 6 again. Night Talas 🙃
Night all, rahmat for the chat 🍵
Night Talas. Inversion tomorrow, the mountains will be fog-free I hope 🌙
Night Talas. Early start at the counter tomorrow 👋
Night 🌙 Kids will be up at 6 anyway
Still awake. Shoeing one of the mares at 7, the farrier is late again
Up. Frost on the potato rows, the field is white 🥔❄️
Talas clear this morning, minus 4 in my street. Scraped the car for 10 min
Kayırluu tañ! Is the 14 bus running? Trying to get to the lesson by 8
Kayırluu tañ. Yes so far, the Trans-Talas lane is open again. Marshrutka 38 to Nurzhan if you want it faster
Rahmat! Going bus 14 then, I like the seat by the window 🙂
Kids at kindergarten have colds again. Don't come in if you're coughing please 🙏
Salam. Counter opens at 9. Anyone's old Nokia still charging? Nobody brings those in anymore lol
Rustam ask Bakyt he still has one in his truck 😂
It's in the glovebox, works, 2 years of battery left maybe
Nurzhan 177 on the air app this morning. Nobody should be jogging there today
Talas is 119 on that same app. Still bad for kids. Keep the windows shut and dampen the stove 🙏
Iyık Janyl 144 and it's fog there too, they said inversion till noon
Bazar changers at 11.45 buy, 12.00 sell for dollars this morning. Euro 12.55 / 13.15
Tellers got the same sheet. Nobody is buying dollars, everyone is asking about euros 😅
My son wants to go to Germany next year, he asks me every day what 1 euro is in som. 9.25 official right? 😩
Official cross is 9.25 yes. Changers always take their cut, tell him to shop around
Old City is white on the top again. Lovely 🏔️
Hippodrome board says Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr on the 21st, 19:00 at the State Hippodrome. Round 11 of the ulak. I'll bring the grey
Kyzyl-Adyr is clear and -2 at night, not a bad day for their trip
Anyone know a good 1-room in Talas? I'm paying 1,500 for a shoebox near the Philharmonic, that's the top of the range I hear
Top end yes. Near the station you can find 1,000. Ask in the marshrutka group, people post flats there
Potatoes at the bazar, 2.10 a kilo now. Last week it was 2 in the inner rows, prices creep up with the cold
Jakshı. I'll buy a sack for the kindergarten kitchen then
Heating is on everywhere now. My radiator clanks like a horse in the night lol
Mine doesn't warm the kitchen at all. Blanket and kettle 🫖
Who is coming Thursday? Tündük 18:30, I need someone to talk about weather with, my students only want to talk about phones
Me! Practising the word for inversion. Temperature inversion is 'harmu' or 'tumanı', right?
Tumanı is the one everyone uses. Good, you're ready 👍
[sticker: haha]
Toktogul reservoir is 83% full and dropping, 15.82 of 19 km³. Water year looks ok but the dam guys are not relaxed
Drawing down 51 million m³ in one day, is that normal for November?
Winter releases, yes. Just means the electricity sellers are busy 😄
Tyre shop, first customer of the day brought a car with summer tyres on the Fergana road. Winter tyres or chains, people, the pass is cold 🚗
The Ala-Bel gateway is open with chains. Suusamyr and Otmek are closed for winter, don't try it
[poll: Thursday Tündük exchange: are you coming?] yes / no / after lesson
Ooh, a poll, you're all very organised today 😂
Anyone at Attelkom internet? The lines are down again in the north part of Talas, Tulpar works though
Same here near the station. Smartphone data ok, wifi keeps dropping
Lunch. Chicken plov at the bank canteen, 28 som a plate. Not bad today 🍚
Plov at 28 is the same as always, what's special about today?
It was actually hot. Stop being negative 😤
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo this week. Cheap for a walnut year, my cousin is buying a sack
22 for walnuts, my grandchildren eat them like sweets, I'll get them a bag
Liberty Boulevard parade is done, nothing like the wind orchestra this time, just a bus 😂
You mean the Swiss band? Did they actually come?
Ha, I meant the bus stop lol. No Swiss, sorry Rustam
Any news on the Jibek Jolu fire report? Still waiting, aunt is selling from home
Nothing yet. Court adjourned until the report comes. Hang in there Nurbek
Rahmat. Every week the same answer
The Herald has a headline: Turkish-Qatari group won the Bukhara terminal deal, 23 years. Talas has no partner like that. Who cares, I want a Bukhara trip
It's the Herald, they write the big ones. Our airport will still be at the end of the queue lol
Bukhara trip is a good idea though. Tickets?
Bus from Talas is 45 to Iyık Janyl first, then more. Long way. I'll stay with my horses 🐎
Anyone watching the Ulak Tartysh sheets? Chu 6-3 Sary-Bulak on the 14th, Talas 2-3 Dastgoh. We're second in ISEZ now? No, third?
Elnur again. ISEZ: Chu top on 26, Talas 22 second. Dastgoh and Iyık Janyl on 16 both
Right, Talas second. Dastgoh lost to us? No, they beat us 3-2 🙃
[sticker: kosh]
Tulpar has 62 now, Neftchi on 63. One point. Last round is done, so that's the league 😤
Dang. Last day was 2-1 to Neftchi, I watched it on my phone at the counter
Neftchi are champions. Irad Cup final is on the 7th, Neftchi v Attelkom, that's over too
Bah. Season ticket money well spent anyway 🙂
Women's League: Tulpar first on 23, Universitet 22. Congrats to the girls
Women's side finished strong, Universitet won their last one 3-2 vs Iyık Janyl. Teachers are proud 😂
Sat 12 Dec, play-off semi-finals at the Hippodrome. ISEZ place 1 v Highland place 2 at 19:00, the second one at 21:00. Horse people go to the second, I'm told
Good people stay late, I've heard that somewhere 😄
[sticker: horse_love]
Dinner. Tea and bread at home, nan from the bazar is 3.50 a loaf and still the best 🍞
Anyone else's power blink this evening? Lights went down for a sec on Ak-Suu street
Normal supply in Talas per the outage page. Maybe your neighbours' heater 😅
Power is fine in the villages too. Our side has been stable all week
Heating bill arrived. Coal and firewood are the real cost this winter, not the power
Coal is the thing. Half my salary goes to the stove 😩
Thinking of moving to Iyık Janyl. A 1-room is 600 to 1,000 there. Air is 144 though, same as the fog
Clean air is worth a lot. Ask around, the Iyık Janyl people are friendly 🙂
Iyık Janyl has fog and inversion tonight, bring a mask to the walk 😷
Round 11 of ISEZ is Sat 21st. Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00, Hippodrome. Who's going? Elnur's cousin is playing 😄
Elnur, your cousin again. Sure, I'll come to see the ulak
I'll come, first match in Talas for me 🐎
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Tulpar Talas ticket for Sat 12 Dec, did anyone see the price? Season ticket covers it
Season holders in, others at the gate. Don't ask me the number
Kids asleep, finally. Night tea and a book 📖
Quiet night in the Old City, fog coming down the hill. Who's still up? 🌫️
Me. Waiting for the Jibek Jolu report, lol. Still nothing
Nurbek, same. Tomorrow at the exchange booth, pass the word if you hear
Writing my Iradi for Thursday. Tumanı, harmu, all of it 😅
Early shift tomorrow. Night Talas 🌙
Night. Potatoes at 5 again 🥔
[sticker: salam]
Night all, rahmat for the chat 🍵
Night Talas. Let's hope the inversion lifts. Kayırluu tañ
Night. Cash count at 6 again 🙃
Night 🌙 Kids will be up at 6 anyway

nurzhan.t: Не спится. Смена завтра в шесть, а в голове одни трубы 🙃
Андрей, у тебя хоть батарея тёплая?
Тёплая, но в спальне холодно. Дети под одеялом
Доброе утро, Нуржан ☀️ На улице -5, в окне морозно, но солнце уже есть
Доброе утро. Дастгох опять без воды до обеда? 😒
Нет, сегодня вроде нормально. Но в ванну набрать всё равно стоит
Айбек, ты сегодня рано. Что, опять Гидромет смотрел? 😄
Гидромет сказал: ясно, до +8 днём. Я сказал: ну наконец-то
Good morning! Going to the lab. Dilnoza, I'll meet you at 10 at the entrance 🙂
Ага, в 10 у входа. Не опаздывай, Волк не любит ждать
Понятно 😅 Rahmat!
Кто-нибудь заходил в Ак Дем на Навбахоре? Хочу взять ребёнку курточку, сейчас холодно
Там дороговато, но качественно. На Дастгохе на базаре дешевле, но сама смотри на швы
Ок, спасибо, схожу на базар в субботу
Кстати, про монеты. Вы же поняли, что Dilnoza пойдёт в лабораторию завтра, а не сегодня?
Игорь, сегодня я в лаборатории и так. Завтра со всеми сразу, не путай 😂
Хорошо, хорошо. Только без рук 🙂
Ребят, в Талас в четверг надо. Маршрутка Нуржан–Талас всё ещё 38?
38 и была. Выезжай до семи вечера, потом частники по 60
Понял, спасибо 👍
Ребят, кто про тулпар-чат? Тут писали про курс. Не пойму, что это за монета
Tulparcoin? Это оффшорная штука, не законное платёжное средство. Котировка утром 3.60 цента, +2.5%
То есть на базаре не возьмут, понятно 🙂
Ага, на базаре только сомы и доллары 😂
Коллеги, у нас в строительной фирме опять гонят сроки. Бухгалтерия как всегда крайняя 🙃
Оксана, у нас на смене то же самое. Только у нас ещё и трубы текут
Lunch time. Plov in the canteen near the gate, 28 som. Not bad 🙂
Плов за 28 это уже неплохо. У нас в столовой дешевле не будет
Аигерим, а ты на заводе уже освоилась? Тяжело после Таласа?
Lab is fine. People are kind. The air here is different, I have a headache some days 😅
Это inversion, в такие дни PM2.5 растёт. Сегодня по Нуржану около 107 по индексу, для чувствительных уже вредно
Дети гулять не пускаю, только до школы и обратно 😔
Окна закрывайте и увлажнитель если есть. Помогает немного
Сидим тут, а на Талас–Дастгох все машины в пробке у моста 🙃
Андрей, у вас же пятерку на Талас сегодня? Нет, это была Нуржан 🙂
Айбек, ты сегодня без кофе?
Игорь, а правда что у вас в Политехе стенд по стеклу будет?
Нет, Костя, это в марте. Пока только рабочие семинары
Тут у нас на Навбахоре новую школу открыли, Свет, как там дочь? Или сын?
Сын, Оксана. Столовая наконец работает, он доволен. Солнечные панели на крыше ещё не видел 😅
Гидромет на завтра опять: облачно, +10 днём, -2 ночью
Айбек, мы поняли, ты любишь Гидромет 😄
Гидромет меня любит, я его уважаю
Ребята, Монеты с Рабат-и-Сафеда: Волк говорит, музей всё ещё просит, а университет ждёт публикацию
Пока публикации нет, никто их никуда не отдаст. Удобно
Are the coins from the 1100s? Dilnoza said Karakhanid 🙂
Да, караханидские. Завтра покажу, если разрешат
Игорь, завтра в Нуржан привезут тёплую воду на Навбахор или ещё нет?
Насчёт воды не знаю, но котельные на окраинах работают. Свет нормальный, плановых отключений не объявляли
Спасибо. Хоть свет есть 🙂
Ребят, Нефтчи в воскресенье? Нет, уже чемпионы, но сезон закончился. Ну что, поздравляем 🏆
Нефтчи чемпионы, 63 очка! Тулпар вторые на 62. Один очко отрыв 😂
Мужчины, вы опять про футбол 😄
Свет, мы же про чемпионов, это серьёзно 🙂
Свет, у вас с Навбахора будет тепло к вторнику? Обещали
Обещали, посмотрим. Соседи говорят, вчера трубы шумели
Dastgoh water tomorrow at 14:00 again? Oksana, you said you'd write 😅
Айгерим, пока ничего не объявляли. Напишу, если будет
Кто завтра на Талас–Нуржан с субботой? Маршрутка 38, автобус 32 если без спешки
Я на автобусе, в маршрутке тесно. 32 норм
Аигерим, завтра в 10 у входа. Если Волк опоздает, не ругаемся
